dedupe_keys.name: monthly morphological measurements of vlugtenburg beach nl 2009 2012

description: TU Delft provides RTK-GPS coastal cross-shore profiles measured with a jetski and walking surveys after beach nourishment at Vlugtenburg. Profiles include foreshore to minus 10 metres depth, beach and part of the dune area. The source states 38 combined surveys and 78 individual surveys represented in time entries. Coverage: 2009/2012. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The two survey counts are distinct levels and are not silently equated. A linked note describes their correspondence but was not read. Exact survey dates, coordinate datum and measurement accuracy are unstated beyond source fields. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
